notes.title: BLACK FRIDAY LOCO SALE
notes.content:
The Blue Comet  - the seashore's finest train 

Jump aboard the famous Blue Comet passenger train, hauled by the CNJ's powerful G3s Pacific's in blue or black liveries, or the later weathered version as the P47 class.

[previewyoutube=yIfFthH3hyg;full][/previewyoutube]

The package includes the Baldwin G3s Pacific locomotive in early condition, in both blue and black liveries, and a custom cab interior. Also included is a representation of the class as it appeared in later life on duty after Blue Comet services had been discontinued.

The set of fully featured rolling stock includes baggage, combine, coach, diner and observation cars, and each comes with a detailed passenger view enabling you to immerse in the nostalgic atmosphere. Take a seat at a table in the dining car or sneak up for a peak at the galley. Ride in style in the lavishly appointed coaches, pull up a wicker chair in the observation car, stowaway in the baggage car or chew tobacco in the smoker.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/585440/Trainz_2019_DLC_Blue_Comet/?curator_clanid=34092165

[hr][/hr]

Pro Train ICE 4

For almost 30 years the fast ICE trains have been determining the high-speed traffic in Germany.

[previewyoutube=v689rdAcndY;full][/previewyoutube]

The engineers in charge repeatedly set new benchmarks with sundry series. The latest series- the ICE 4- has been thundering along the rails with a top speed of impressive 250 km/h since 2017. 3DZUG has designed this train with an unprecedented detail degree. Each wagon has been elaborately crafted both on the in- and outside, so that you can enjoy this masterpiece of German engineering just as the original. This package features 5 different liveries of the ICE 4.


  livery red, Climate saver "green",  red/green, Covid-19 edition, Germany livery
  realistic high speed train
  realistic drivers cabin
  passenger interiors for 1st, 2nd and restaurant wagon


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2156050/Trainz_2019_DLC__Pro_Train_ICE_4_Collection/?curator_clanid=34092165

[hr][/hr]

Prussian Class G 8


The Prussian Class G 8 locomotives were eight-coupled, superheated, freight locomotives operated by the Prussian state railways.

[previewyoutube=YJgWBkNVUA0;full][/previewyoutube]

There were two variants: the G 8 built from 1902 with a 14 tonne axle load and the 'reinforced G 8' (Verstärkte G 8) built from 1913 (later designated the G 8.1) with a 17-tonne (17-long-ton; 19-short-ton) axle load. The latter was the most numerous German state railway (Länderbahn) locomotive, over 5,000 examples being built.

Features:

  G8 steam locomotive
  G8 tender 
  animated drivers cabin
  realistic PBR model
  tender headlights

notes.title: TRS19 Service Pack 5 Update now availabe
notes.content:
Service Pack 5 is the latest update for Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019, and is now available for all TRS19 owners.

This update delivers a few minor updates as well as a number of bug fixes. Under the hood, this update is trainzbuild 5.0 which means that it is currently compatible with TRS22 routes. Note that this is likely to change when TRS22 is released officially (next month).

Updates:

 Trainzbuild 5.0 (content older than 5.0 will work in this build. Content saved in this build will not work in older builds
 Default ground texture is now based upon the Region selected. To use the old grid texture as your default, download the "Grid Region" asset from the Download Station
 Map options are now found on the Display Menu
 New Content Manager category icons
 New Surveyor (Classic) compass

Changelist:
(NOTE: Some of these issues appeared during the beta phase)


 Fix various derailments on loading certain sessions
 Fix some switches in cabins that were in the wrong position when entering the cab
 Fix an issue where session layer trains could been moved to a different layer or hidden
 Fix train vehicle pitch on steep tracks
 Fix car pitch on roads
 Fix drivers not automatically being added in some cases
 Fix an issue where rotated vehicles would reverse again when loading into Driver
 Fix steam loco water not being handled by the Automatic Fireman feature
 Fix various Test Track bugs
 Fix a slow list refresh in CM
 Fix the DB repair progress bar (when validating assets)
 Headlight coronas now working in Quickdrive
 Texture replacement scripts are now working
 Certain ground textures that failed to load now load correctly
 Crash fix for loading a specific map (will help some other cases)
 Non-PBR ground textures now apply at the correct height (track not buried)
 ARN now working correctly
 Sessions options now working correctly
 Environment settings now remembered
 Merge route [dialog minimap] now shows both routes
 Certain signals that would not update on session start now update correctly
 Fixed a hang on loading certain sessions
 Fix for various session freezes (or failure to load fully)


Installing Grid Region
If you prefer the old Grid pattern, or any other default ground texture, follow these steps to change your Region:


 Open Content Manager
 Type "Grid Region" in the search box
 Change the filter to Download Station
 R-click and click Download
 In the Routes Menu select your route to Edit
 Click Edit Menu > Edit Route > Change Region

notes.title: TRS19 Content and Reviews
notes.content:
WHAT’S INCLUDED IN TRS19?

After all the effort that has gone into creating all the routes, sessions and content included in TRS19, it’s a shame that at this early stage we’ve received a few negative reviews from people who, it appears, haven’t installed the full version of the game.

To clarify what is included in the product, there are six routes as follows:

Base Install:
* Kickstarter County, “USA” 

Free Download In-game:
* Sebino Lake, Italy
* Canadian Rockies, Golden, BC
* Edinburgh-Dundee, UK
* Cornish Mainline, UK
* Niddertalbahn, Germany

In addition there are over 130 locos included and over 500 different freight and passenger vehicles. The total value of this content if sold as DLC is well over $200, so we think this is great value for money.

If you have any problems, visit our Trainz Wiki help page here:

GIVE US YOUR REVIEWS

We know, based upon the many, many hours of play logged by thousands of fans over the past ~20 years, that Trainz has a lot to offer. However, there are many more thousands of people out there who haven’t discovered the world of Trainz (yet), and we need your help to let them know what it is all about.

We know that there are many more people enjoying Trainz than we have reviews, so we encourage each of you reading this to write a short review (or a long one if you like) to help people new to Trainz to discover everything there is to offer.

notes.title: Save a Bundle on DLC.
notes.content:
DLC (Downloadable Content) appears to be a very contentious subject in the world of train simulators.

Unlike other games, where DLC items are often required to "compete" (either via power or just looking the part), in a train sim, it is much more about expanding your experience with your favourite DLC loco/route/region. And since everyone has a different favourite, it means that there needs to be a LOT of DLC on offer to provide something for everyone.

Just as Apple doesn't list the total cost of all songs or apps in iTunes, in the same manner, no-one expects anyone to buy all the Trainz DLC listed on the Steam Store. You can think of the full list of DLC items as just one big "store" where you browse and pick the items you're interested in, while ignoring the majority of items that aren't your cup of tea (just like when you visit iTunes).

Another point often raised is the cost of the DLC items. The cost is related to the enormous amount of work that is required to make the items, along with the obvious "niche" train sim community following. Without a market of millions of players to buy all the various items, an individual DLC can sometimes look expensive.

Almost all the content in Trainz is made by people just like you - Trainz Community members. To help lower the prices on the DLC and still ensure that our content creators are rewarded for their efforts, we've put together a large range of bundles that offer 40 to 75% off, making it that much easier to access more DLC for less.

When you click on a DLC item you will see which Bundles it is also included in. The price shown to you is for the remaining items in the bundle that aren't already in your collection.

Here is a list of the Bundles currently available with prices ranging from 40 - 75% off:


 NS Loco Pack

Don't forget also that Trainz has a HUGE range of free-to-download content on the Trainz Download Station (DLS). There are literally hundreds to top quality routes, and thousands of locos to add to your collection without spending a penny (although we do encourage you to grab a First Class Ticket, which you can do for free this week by visiting your MyTrainz page). 

To find DLS content, use the new Main Menu in-game filter, or open Content Manager and filter on Download Station, then begin to search and explore.

notes.title: TRS19 - Coming Soon To Steam
notes.content:
The latest (and definitely the greatest) version of Trainz will soon be coming to Steam. (Check our TRS19 landing page at our Trainzportal website)

Click Follow to ensure you don't miss out on any of the upcoming announcements (like we will have a brand new trailer to show you "real soon").

Updates:
The release date will depend upon the Steam Store review process - but we're very close.

Price will be USD$69.99 which includes:
* 6 routes + 40 sessions + 10 Tutorials
* Over 100 locos
* Over 500 freight and passenger cars
* Over 17,000 scenery items

So just for the content that works out to roughly:
* $5 per route
* $0.50 per session
* $0.10 cents per loco, and 
* $0.02 cents per wagon
* 16,000 more items free!

You can choose to download all, or just as many of these built-in routes as you like using our in-game Asset Download system. These are not part of the "Trainz Download Station" and therefore not subject to download limits. 

There is no discount for Trainz A New Era owners, but any TANE built-in content and DLC content you own will be available to download free in-game into TRS19.
If you have any questions, feel free to ask them here.
